svg.title: KONKRED product suite
svg.desc: Four workflow benches: Audit, Enterprise, Redeye and Arbitra. Each card shows its id, name, what goes in, what comes out, run time and difficulty.

g.text: audit a prompt, price it, and stamp it certified before it ships
turn a licensed prompt into a standalone tool with its own interface
throw 367 catalogued attacks at a model and grade what gets through
license the library, then orchestrate it into autonomous agents
